Privacy Policy

Last updated: February 2026

1. Information We Collect

When you submit a quote request through our website, we collect your name, phone number, email address, and address. This information is used solely to respond to your enquiry and provide our cleaning services.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your personal information is used to contact you regarding your cleaning quote, schedule appointments, and provide our services. We do not sell, trade, or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

3. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, loss, and unauthorised access. Our contact form is processed securely via Formspree.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or wish to access, update, or delete your personal information, please contact us at info@cleantonexpress.com.au or call 0426 263 806.

5. Compliance

This policy is in accordance with the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).
